signing.windows: Unsigned; publisher signing has not been configured
signing.macos: Ad hoc build signature; no Developer ID signing or notarization
signing.linux: Archive SHA-256 checksums; no detached publisher signature

release_features: Write clean Markdown by default: minimal escaping, images as ![alt](src), no form-control or list-item records and no page landmark chrome.
Accept PDF, DOCX, XLSX and other supported documents through --url.
Decode legacy HTML charsets such as koi8-r and windows-1251, and request gzip responses.
Finish JavaScript capture when the page becomes quiet.
release_fixes: Fix PDF word spacing in tightly kerned text, such as LaTeX output.
Keep rotated watermark text out of PDF prose.
Fall back to the full page when --article finds no article, instead of refusing.
Follow URL redirects whose location contains raw spaces.
Report the real refusal stage and resource_url.
Try the next address before any request bytes are sent.
Keep a JavaScript capture when one sub-request fails.

features: Offline PDF, DOCX, PPTX, workbook and static HTML conversion
EPUB 2/3 conversion with Unicode and publication navigation
Explicit URL acquisition and optional isolated JavaScript capture
